note: Each case reverses a real upstream bug fix, so the pull request reads like a small refactor that reintroduces the bug. Ground truth is the set of lines the fix had removed. Descriptions are written for a reviewer: what the change breaks.

cases.description: Drops the guard for an empty key list, so res.format with only a default handler passes an empty array to req.accepts and errors instead of using the default.
Removes the IP check, so a host like 127.0.0.1 is split on dots and req.subdomains returns IP octets as subdomains.
Windows absolute paths written with forward slashes (C:/dir) are no longer recognised as absolute.
mountpath is set from the raw first argument instead of the resolved mount path, so app.use(subapp) without a path gives subapp the wrong mountpath.
The redirect body uses the raw url argument instead of the resolved address, so the body shows a different target than the Location header.
Splitting the Host header on ':' truncates IPv6 literals such as [::1]:3000 to '['.
Without the leading slash check, any path containing :// (for example /proxy/http://x) is treated as a fully qualified URL and routed wrongly.
The user's formatError result is no longer returned as is; a newline is appended to output the user explicitly controls.
The URL pattern now strips any host from stack traces instead of only karma's own hostname and port, mangling third party URLs.
Document#update no longer returns the Query, so callers cannot chain, exec or await it.
Without the indexOf check, a +field already present in the projection is overwritten with 1, clobbering a $slice projection on that path.
With full versioning, increment() alone leaves no dirty paths, so $__delta returns early and the version bump is never saved.
Model.remove ignores its conditions and builds the query from {}, deleting every document in the collection.
TOC entries use the heading's raw HTML instead of escaped text, so markup in a heading is injected into the generated TOC (XSS).
The toString() calls are removed, so a numeric title or slug makes slugize throw.
